The locator gives study 1, a broad intentional-action/skill/control/luck description, and pages 8 and 10, but no vignette contrast or question. On PDF p. 8 (printed p. 347), Case 1 has distinct correct-number and explosion-prevention intentionality judgments (38% and 73%). PDF p. 10 (printed p. 349) gives Case 3 correct-number and lottery-winning judgments (80% and 67% negative responses), followed by separate dice cases. Printed p. 348 compares Case 1 and Case 2 correct-number judgments, linked by note 3 to chi-square 6.3, p < 0.025. Printed p. 350 additionally gives chi-square 6.6, p < 0.01 for killing/winning judgments and chi-square 18.46, p < 0.001 for rolling-six judgments. These are distinct tests; study 1 alone does not identify the target contrast/outcome. No target selected by numbering or metric matching. The source prints chi-square statistics, not Kendall's W, in these inferential passages. No conversion attempted. The p. 350 killing/winning comparison labels the winning group C4 although the preceding results list labels that question C5; this printed inconsistency is retained, not repaired.
